artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: verbatim catch-up sync of .opencode/scripts/command-gate-in.sh, with executed before/after test evidence in both source-store and deployed modes, and two spawn candidates.

completion_data.completion_summary: Restored the single-source-of-truth invariant for .opencode/scripts/command-gate-in.sh via a byte-identical cp from the already-correct source-store file, verified by diff/exec-bit/bash-n/lint checks and a full before/after test-run comparison in both source-store and deployed modes. test-common-lib.sh now passes (Failed: 0) in both modes; deployed run-all.sh moved from 27p/7f to 28p/6f with no new failures introduced.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, .opencode/ and .claude/ are both generated deploy targets from the same agent-system/extensions/** source store, driven by config.claude() vs config.opencode() in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/config.lua. deploy-headless.sh only supports .claude/ (hardcodes ext_config.claude()), so .opencode/ can drift stale with no headless catch-up path -- only the interactive picker or a manual single-file cp can resync it. When a deployed-mode-only test failure traces to .opencode/, check whether the source-store equivalent is already correct before editing; if so, the fix is a verbatim cp, never a hand-authored edit of the deploy target.
